pages.title: Easter Bunny Coloring Page
pages.description: A seated Easter bunny fills this printable coloring page, with tall ears, a bow tie, and front paws resting against a tuft of chest fur. Small patches of grass frame its feet.

pages.title: Easter Egg Coloring Page
pages.description: One large decorated egg fills this printable coloring page with bands of zigzags, circles, and smooth curved stripes. The pattern leaves broad areas between the rows of dots.

pages.title: Easter Basket Coloring Page
pages.description: A woven Easter basket holds three decorated eggs in this printable coloring page, beneath an arched handle topped with a ribbon bow. The eggs show dots, zigzags, and wavy stripes.

pages.title: Easter Egg Hunt Coloring Page
pages.description: Two children look for Easter eggs in this printable coloring page, with one pointing into a bush while the other holds a basket of eggs. Flowers and a fence frame the garden.

pages.title: Happy Easter Lettering Coloring Page
pages.description: Rounded Happy Easter letters headline this printable coloring page above a bunny holding a patterned egg between a chick and a lamb. Spring flowers sit beside and below the greeting.

pages.title: Easter Chick Hatching Coloring Page
pages.description: An Easter chick stretches its wings in this printable coloring page as it emerges from an eggshell decorated with flowers and dots. A cracked piece of shell rests on its head.

pages.title: Easter Bunny Face Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling Easter bunny face fills this printable coloring page, with tall ears, curved whiskers, and a bow tie under its chin. Broad shapes define the ears and cheeks.

pages.title: Easter Bunny with Basket Coloring Page
pages.description: An Easter bunny carries a basket of patterned eggs in this printable coloring page, resting one paw at its hip beneath a broad bow tie. Woven strips curve around the basket.

pages.title: Easter Bunny Painting Eggs Coloring Page
pages.description: An apron-wearing Easter bunny brushes stripes onto an egg in this printable coloring page, with a paint pot and a basket on its worktable. The apron has a rounded front pocket.

pages.title: Easter Bunny and Chick Coloring Page
pages.description: An Easter bunny and chick raise a paw and wing toward each other in this printable coloring page, beside a large egg with a band of flowers. Small tufts of grass sit below them.

pages.title: Easter Bunny Pulling a Wagon Coloring Page
pages.description: A bow-tied Easter bunny pulls a wagon of decorated eggs in this printable coloring page, holding the handle while stepping forward with one foot. Wooden slats and round wheels define the wagon.

pages.title: Easter Bunny Delivering Eggs Coloring Page
pages.description: An Easter bunny leaves a decorated egg on a cottage step in this printable coloring page, carrying a basket beside a round-topped door. A small window and stepping stones frame the delivery.

pages.title: Easter Bunny in a Carrot Car Coloring Page
pages.description: An Easter bunny grips the wheel of a carrot-shaped car in this printable coloring page, with leafy carrot tops behind the seat and two large wheels below. Its ears rise above the steering wheel.

pages.title: Easter Bunny Burrow Coloring Page
pages.description: An Easter bunny rests in a bed inside its burrow in this printable coloring page, with a hanging lantern, round window, and tray of patterned eggs. Flowers grow on the hill above.

pages.title: Easter Bunny Family Picnic Coloring Page
pages.description: Three Easter bunnies share a picnic blanket in this printable coloring page, with a small bunny holding an egg between two adults. A woven basket and more decorated eggs sit on the blanket.

pages.title: Easter Bunny Holding a Giant Egg Coloring Page
pages.description: An Easter bunny holds a giant striped egg in this printable coloring page, with both paws around the shell and a bow tie visible beside it. Broad curved bands cross the egg.

pages.title: Easter Bunny Popping Out of an Egg Coloring Page
pages.description: An Easter bunny peeks out of a cracked egg in this printable coloring page, with its paws curled over the jagged rim. Flowers and wavy stripes decorate the lower shell.

pages.title: Easter Lamb Coloring Page
pages.description: An Easter lamb stands beside tulips and a lily in this printable coloring page, wearing a bow beneath its curly fleece and floppy ears. Four small hooves show below the wool.

pages.title: Easter Duckling with Eggs Coloring Page
pages.description: A duckling stands beside two Easter eggs in this printable coloring page, with webbed feet, a folded wing, and spring flowers around the patterned shells. Tulip stems rise behind the eggs.

pages.title: Easter Chicks in a Basket Coloring Page
pages.description: Two Easter chicks peek over a basket rim in this printable coloring page, below a large bow and behind three patterned eggs. The woven basket curves around the chicks.

pages.title: Easter Gnome Coloring Page
pages.description: An Easter gnome holds a basket of eggs in this printable coloring page, with a curled hat, bushy beard, and broad boots. A bunny emblem decorates the striped hat.

pages.title: Easter Bonnet Coloring Page
pages.description: An Easter bonnet tilts across this printable coloring page, with a wide brim, a large ribbon bow, and a cluster of flowers and leaves. Long ribbon tails follow the brim.

pages.title: Easter Lilies Coloring Page
pages.description: Three Easter lilies open across this printable coloring page, with trumpet-shaped blooms, slender stamens, and pointed leaves along the stems. Fine curves add detail inside the petals.

pages.title: Easter Tulips and Eggs Coloring Page
pages.description: Three tulips rise behind two decorated Easter eggs in this printable coloring page, with long pointed leaves and patterns of hearts, dots, and zigzags. Grass blades frame the base.

pages.title: Easter Egg Wreath Coloring Page
pages.description: A bunny peeks through an Easter egg wreath in this printable coloring page, resting its paws above a bow surrounded by decorated eggs and leaves. Round flowers fill gaps between the eggs.

pages.title: Easter Egg Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Patterned Easter eggs hang from the branches of a small tree in this printable coloring page, tied with ribbons among pointed leaves and blossoms. The trunk stands on a patch of grass.

pages.title: Easter Egg Garland Coloring Page
pages.description: Two swags of Easter eggs span this printable coloring page, with bows at the ends and hanging ornaments patterned with hearts, stars, flowers, and stripes. Each egg hangs from a short cord.

pages.title: Easter Egg Mandala Coloring Page
pages.description: A floral mandala fills a large Easter egg in this printable coloring page, with rounded petals at the center and symmetrical bands of leaves, flowers, and scallops. Curved borders cap the design.

pages.title: Pysanky Easter Eggs Coloring Page
pages.description: A girl in a flower crown holds three Ukrainian pysanky in this printable coloring page, with geometric bands, eight-pointed stars, and diamonds across the eggs. Her braids frame the arrangement.

pages.title: Stained Glass Easter Eggs Coloring Page
pages.description: An arched stained-glass design frames a bunny and patterned Easter eggs in this printable coloring page, with curved panel lines and flowers at the base. The bunny holds the center egg.

pages.title: Easter Egg Template Coloring Page
pages.description: A single blank Easter egg outline fills this printable coloring page, leaving an open interior for drawing stripes, dots, or original decorations. The smooth edge stands out on white paper.

pages.title: Kids Dyeing Easter Eggs Coloring Page
pages.description: Two children dip Easter eggs into cups in this printable coloring page, using wire holders at a table with a woven basket of eggs. Both children wear aprons.

pages.title: Easter Egg Roll Coloring Page
pages.description: Two children roll decorated Easter eggs down a slope in this printable coloring page, crouching with spoons as the eggs move ahead of them. Motion marks curve beside the patterned shells.

pages.title: Easter Egg Spoon Race Coloring Page
pages.description: A boy balances an Easter egg on a spoon in this printable coloring page, running past a finish ribbon with empty grid squares. The egg has zigzags and dots.

pages.title: Chocolate Easter Bunny Coloring Page
pages.description: A molded chocolate Easter bunny sits in an open wrapper in this printable coloring page, with long ears, a ribbon bow, and paws resting against its belly. Fold lines define the wrapper.

pages.title: Easter Peeps Coloring Page
pages.description: Three Easter Peeps sit on a plate in this printable coloring page, with a long-eared bunny shape behind two marshmallow chicks. Simple outlines leave the candy shapes open for coloring.

pages.title: Easter Bunny Cupcake Coloring Page
pages.description: An Easter cupcake fills this printable coloring page, topped with two bunny-ear decorations and scattered sprinkles above a ridged paper wrapper. Wide frosting swirls separate the topping into curved sections.

pages.title: Easter Sunday Brunch Coloring Page
pages.description: An Easter brunch table fills this printable coloring page with hot cross buns, sliced eggs, two cups, and a vase of tulips. A folded napkin sits between the plates.

pages.title: Easter Cross with Lilies Coloring Page
pages.description: A wooden Easter cross rises above trumpet-shaped lilies in this printable coloring page, with thin wood-grain lines and pointed leaves around the base. Several petals overlap the foot of the cross.

pages.title: He Is Risen Coloring Page
pages.description: He Is Risen lettering fills the top of this printable coloring page, with hollow rounded letters above a sunrise, Easter lilies, and tulips. Short rays spread over the hills.

pages.title: Empty Tomb Coloring Page
pages.description: An open tomb anchors this printable coloring page, with a round stone rolled aside, a cloth on the stone bench, and three crosses in the distance. A path curves toward the entrance.

pages.title: Jesus Resurrection Coloring Page
pages.description: The risen Jesus stands beside the open tomb in this printable coloring page, wearing a draped robe and sandals as the sun rises behind the hills. Thin rays frame his head.

pages.title: Palm Sunday Coloring Page
pages.description: Jesus rides a donkey into Jerusalem in this printable coloring page, raising one hand as people hold palm branches near the city gate. The donkey steps forward with one hoof raised.

pages.title: Last Supper Coloring Page
pages.description: Bread and a cup represent the Last Supper in this printable coloring page, arranged on a cloth-covered table beneath an arched stone window. A crack separates the two pieces of flatbread.

pages.title: Good Friday Three Crosses Coloring Page
pages.description: Three wooden crosses stand on a hill in this printable coloring page, with a taller cross at the center and clouds above the smaller crosses. Fine lines mark the wood grain.

pages.title: Easter Sunrise Service Coloring Page
pages.description: People gather outdoors for an Easter sunrise service in this printable coloring page, facing a church and a draped cross as the sun rises. Lilies grow beneath the cross.

pages.title: Bluey Easter Egg Hunt Coloring Page
pages.description: Bluey points toward a hidden egg in this printable coloring page while Bingo looks beside the garden bush. A fence frames the scene behind the two dogs.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Easter Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty paints a patterned Easter egg in this printable coloring page, wearing a bunny-ear headband beside a small basket and a paint palette. Flowers decorate the egg below the brush.

pages.title: Snoopy Easter Coloring Page
pages.description: Snoopy holds a decorated Easter egg in this printable coloring page, wearing bunny ears while Woodstock stands beside a woven basket. Zigzags and circles wrap around the egg.
